name: How long does it take to install an outdoor refrigerator?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install an outdoor refrigerator?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for an outdoor refrigerator typically ranges from a few hours for a basic freestanding unit to a full day or more for built-in models requiring custom cabinetry or new electrical wiring. Factors like site preparation, complexity of electrical work, and any necessary plumbing connections will influence the duration. Hometelligent Inc. provides a project timeline after an initial site assessment, giving you a clear expectation of when your outdoor kitchen will be fully operational.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies from a few hours to a full day or more, depending on the unit type and electrical/plumbing complexity. We provide a timeline after assessment.
